text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's early morning on the big day when
Seiun Sky
is set to start seriously training
for the Twinkle
Series.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Here we go... Oh, would you look at
that?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
The wind's calm, the waves are gentle...
This is the
perfect weather for fishing.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Go ahead, cast your line. You can prop
your
fishing rod up on the cooler there.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Then all that's left is to relax a bit,
snooze a little,
and sit tight till you get a
nibble. Easy, right?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Huh? But I had today down as "Fishing
Day ☆" on
my calendar.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I'm just kidding. I know what day
it is.
choice_data_list: I explained it properly, didn't I...?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
It's the day we get serious! Yep, the
most crucial
of crucial turning points.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: So, I'm gonna make an absolutely no-nonsense suggestion right here and now. That is why we have to go fishing!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I wanna set the mood by catching a big one! ☆ If we don't flounder here, these next three years will be breaming with joy!
choice_data_list: And what's the meaning behind that?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: You're just gonna let that one hang?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Whatever! We'll totally, probably catch

something. Then we can start training
after that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky is pretty fickle. She's probably
just
using that mood maker stuff as an
excuse to get
out of training. But still...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ohh? So you're confident that we'll land
a lunker?
choice_data_list: Once you catch one, we're heading ...
Once you catch one, we'll head bac...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
What's gonna happen next? Stay tuned
after this
commercial break! Or
something like that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sky says this jokingly, but thirty minutes
later...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh... I think I got a bite. ♪ Get the net
ready!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Come on, come on—the net! I'm reeling
it iiin...
Hup!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And then...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Splash!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Look at this beaut! It's a sixteen-inch
flounder!
That's a whopper and no
fooling! ♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Boooy, I can't believe it. Never thought
I'd pull in
one this big.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
And so! I hereby present this flounder to
you,
Trainer. Don't be shy.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yep, just my way of showing my honest

appreciation for coming out with me so
early in
the morning.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Plus... we're gonna get an even bigger
catch if we
keep at it together, right?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Next year, I wanna catch at least three
fish. One
in April, one in May, and
theeen one in October.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki Sho, the Japanese Derby,
and the
Kikuka Sho—the dates all line
up with the Classic
Triple Crown!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Okay! We have to get to work while
the fish is
still fresh.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I've got a cutting board, a knife, and a
whole set
of seasonings right here! I
even brought a pot to
cook with!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
All that's left is for you to clean the
fish. ☆

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Who else? You're not gonna let a dainty
Uma like
me wave a kitchen knife
around, are ya?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I need a break anyway. It was kind of a
pain
searching around for fishing
sp—oops.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Uh... I wasn't supposed to say that part
out loud.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Fishing has its charms even if you
don't catch anything, but since you were
gonna be joining
me, I really wanted to
snag something good.
choice_data_list: You really worked hard on the prep.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I did some research, read the tides, and
came up with a plan. If that's what it
takes to win, then
that's what I'm gonna
do, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Nah. I wish my races went this smoothly.
choice_data_list: Just like in a race, huh.
Just like in a race, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well... That's enough chitchat, I'd say.
I'll see ya
when I wake up.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Wake me when the food's done,
preferably by
holding a spoonful of
broth under my nose. ♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Thanks in advance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's Seiun Sky, an ever-drifting cloud
that no one can manage to grasp. Our
journey to reel in
the "big catch" has
finally begun!
